name: Moments
storyline:
Xiaomai is an ordinary office worker living in Taipei with her two roommates, Xiaobai and Yami.

After an argument, Xiaobai mysteriously falls into a deep sleep. Soon after, the words in their shared diary begin to disappear, and mysterious little creatures known as Hibimon scatter throughout the city.

As Xiaomai navigates her everyday life, she encounters Hibimon hidden among familiar streets and ordinary moments. Through exploration, photographs, and fragments of memories, she begins to uncover the connection between the missing diary entries, these mysterious creatures, and her sleeping roommate.
summary:
Moments is a cozy, story-driven adventure and collection game developed by Taiwanese independent game studio MUGIO.

The story follows Xiaomai, an office worker living in Taipei, and her roommates Xiaobai and Yami. After Xiaobai mysteriously falls into a deep sleep, the words in their shared diary begin to disappear, and mysterious creatures called Hibimon scatter throughout the city.

Players explore everyday urban environments, experience interactive stories and mini-games, photograph and collect Hibimon, and piece together memories through diary entries. The game combines slice-of-life storytelling, exploration, puzzles, and creature collection.
